subject: APPROVED S20 @1d5b19c, conditional on CI 44039452962 green (single head 0031; prod player refuses loopback; deploy guard works; deployed player.js identical; smoke 72/72 x2)
body:
Final review of S20 at 1d5b19c (8e5b86f migration renumber + 1d5b19c loopback/comment). Reviewer: review20. Previous reviews: 20261117T063040-review20-4a5739, 20261117T071808-review20-148cfd.

## Verdict: APPROVED, conditional on CI run 44039452962 (1d5b19c) going green
All 13 jobs of that run were still queued at 07:45Z, so the full 3 browsers × 6 viewports matrix and the CI db job are not judged here. Do not `verify` S20 until that run is green. If anything S20-owned is red, treat this as CHANGES REQUESTED.

### The lead's checks
- **Single head:** migration 0031_s20_review has down_revision 0030 (generation). `tests/test_migrate.py` passes 8/8. A fresh `naadi_api.migrate` on a new local DB reaches 0031 (naadi_alembic_version), and flashcards.source_id is present.
- **Production player refuses loopback:** deploy/player-space/player.js:23 is `var ALLOW_LOOPBACK = false`.
  - Live check against the DEPLOYED Space: a parent on http://127.0.0.1 gets zero messages and no YouTube frame.
  - Foreign https://evil.example with `?parent=` set to evil, to the Naadi Space, or to loopback: all refused.
  - Top-level open: blank.
- **Deploy script refuses a loopback-on file:** scripts/deploy_player_space.sh:23. Run against a copy with `ALLOW_LOOPBACK = true` it exits 1 with "player.js must ship with ALLOW_LOOPBACK = false". Against the repo file it passes. I tested only the guard line, not the upload.
- **Comment fixed:** apps/web/src/video/bridge.ts now says WebKit rejects allow-presentation (console error) and Chromium accepts it. That matches my measurement.
- **Deployed player matches the repo:** player.js is byte-identical (fetched with a cache-buster). index.html differs only by HF's injected head script and og/twitter meta tags (platform-added, before the CSP meta, harmless).
- **Production happy path:** I routed https://arrowassassin-naadi.hf.space to a parent page in Playwright (no change to the real Space). Against the deployed player in Chromium:
  - hello, then ready with rates [0.25…2], then state and time messages, all from exactly the player origin.
  - The nested frame is youtube-nocookie with origin set.
  - fullscreenEnabled is true; the rate command reaches `<video>`.playbackRate = 1.5.
  - Actual play and seek remain unverifiable here (YouTube error 150 in this environment, same as an unsandboxed control). That stays on the device checklist / @live spec.

### Earlier findings: all fixed, nothing new
- Player readiness, fullscreen, both .apkg DoS (view/trigger refused, no recursion, 20 s deadline; linear cloze scanner, 200k-char adversarial fields in 0.02 s), speed label, flashcards.source_id, own-card write check, quota ledger, loopback parent: all fixed.
- The selected speed pill now shows its label: "1.5×" is legible on paper in the fresh phone screenshot (.tmp/shots/video/player--webkit-phone-390.png).
- Parent CSP still has `script-src 'self'`; frame-src adds only the player origin. Lime/ui_copy/phone layout as before.

### Test results at 1d5b19c (local, own stack -review20; hosted DB and Space untouched)
- Unit: 1580 passed.
- Lint and typecheck: pass.
- Vitest: web 635, shared 133, ink 75, ui 27, all pass.
- db (tests/anki, tests/youtube, RLS, RLS coverage, live_check, schema_doc, migrations): 208 passed.
  - 2 failed in test_migrations (round trip, concurrent). The cause is my run order: I had seeded Storage (95 figures) before the db tests, so 0002's downgrade guard correctly refused to drop non-empty buckets. CI runs db tests before seeding. Not a code defect.
- e2e smoke (video + anki + csp, including the prod-CSP routes with zero console errors) on webkit-ipad-portrait, webkit-ipad-landscape, webkit-phone-390 and chromium-laptop-1440, `--retries=0 --workers=2`: **72/72 twice in a row** on a freshly migrated (0031) and seeded DB.
- CI 44039452962: queued, not yet judged (see the condition above).
